description: This file defines a React component for a search results page in a recipe application. It imports components for layout and UI elements such as Sidebar, RecipeGrid, Loading, and EmptyState, and uses an API function searchRecipes to fetch data based on search parameters provided via props.

methods.name: SearchPage
methods.description: An asynchronous React component that fetches recipes based on search query and renders appropriate UI elements depending on loading state, results presence, or empty results.
